name: 02_Proof_of_Address.pdf
summary: Utility bill (Example Utilities, 1 October 2024) used as proof of address.

overlayBoxes.title: Proof of Address Is Current and Names the Client
overlayBoxes.details: The utility bill names Joe Bloggs and is dated 1 October 2024, so it provides current address evidence for the client within the period expected by AML guidance.

overlayBoxes.title: Address Record Is Held on File
overlayBoxes.details: The file contains separate proof-of-address evidence for Joe Bloggs. This supports the record-keeping requirement for address evidence without treating the defective passport record as compliant identity evidence.
